decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:PL01 location Plan, PL02 Site Plan, PL03 Existing floorplans, PL04 Proposed floorplans, Planning Statement, Highway Impact Assessment, Waste Management Plan, Flood Risk Map, Fire Safety Statement, Flood Risk Assessment , CIL form.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until 1 long-stay and 1 short-stay cycle parking space has been provided demonstrating the following:Location :Near entrances or main access  Design: Stands or wall bars  Security: Secure, overlooked, well-lit  Coverage: Covered where possible  Accessibility: Step-free, no obstructions   The cycle parking spaces shall be fully constructed  prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.   Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to conform to Enfield DMD policy 45 and promote sustainable modes of transport.

The development hereby permitted shall be occupied by no more than 4 residents and 2 members of staff (excluding ad hoc visiting specialists/ therapists) at any one time.Reason: To minimise the impact of the development on the occupiers of neighbouring properties and to ensure that car parking provision complies with the Council's adopted standards.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) and the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, or any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting those Orders, the development hereby approved shall be used only for purposes falling within Use Class C2 (children's care home), and for no other purpose.Reason: To ensure that the use of the premises remains appropriate to the character of the area and the assessment of the application, and to prevent the introduction of alternative uses that could give rise to unacceptable impacts on amenity, traffic or the local environment without further consideration by the Local Planning Authority.

Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted drawings, prior to the first occupation of the HMO hereby permitted, waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the permitted number of occupiers shall have been provided on site, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities are to be retained thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets.
description: Change of use from dwelling house (Use Class C3) to Children's Home (Use Class C2).
